messages.content: 我如何找到給定動量的力角度？

function.name: calculate_vector_angle
function.description: Calculate the angle of a vector based on its X and Y components. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

X_component.description: The X component of the vector. This is a float type value.

Y_component.description: The Y component of the vector. This is a float type value.

use_degrees.description: If true, the result will be in degrees. If false, the result will be in radians. Default is false.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "我如何找到給定動量的力角度？" Means: "How do I find the force angle given a momentum?" They want to find the angle of a force given momentum? Possibly they have momentum vector and want to find the angle of the force that produced it? Or maybe they have momentum vector and want to find the angle of the force relative to something? The question is ambiguous. They might want to compute the angle of a vector (momentum) relative to axes. They mention "force angle" but maybe they mean the angle of the momentum vector. They might want to use arctan2(Y, X). So we can explain using vector components. Provide formula: angle = atan2(p_y, p_x). If want degrees, convert. Also mention using the provided function. We can call the function calculate_vector_angle with X_component = momentum_x, Y_component = momentum_y, use_degrees = true. Provide example. Also explain that force angle is same as momentum angle if force direction is same. Provide steps. Use Chinese. Provide code snippet. Use function.
